strategies.name: Mean reversion
strategies.instruments: ~500 liquid US large caps (NSDQ250 universe), SPY regime
strategies.summary: Cross-sectional pullback portfolio: buy the most oversold names (RSI-2) inside their own 200-day uptrend, ≤10 names at once, exit on the first strength. bb / nr7 single-symbol modes remain in the script for reference.
strategies.rule_sketch: Signal at close t: close > SMA200, RSI(2) < entry, no earnings inside the hold window. Rank by RSI; resting limit at close - k×ATR(14) for the next session (passive fill, no spread crossing), ≤10 names, equal notional. Exit at the close when RSI(2) > 70 or close > SMA5, or after max_hold sessions.

strategies.name: Dealer gamma (GEX)
strategies.summary: Dealer gamma positioning sets the intraday regime: long-gamma pins and mean-reverts; short-gamma trends. Reads positioning, not price.
strategies.rule_sketch: Build GEX from the SPX chain (OI × gamma). Trade MES/ES gap-fade or wall-revert when gex_z and walls agree. Signal from the prior close / overnight snapshot.

strategies.name: Vol carry put spreads
strategies.summary: Harvest the variance risk premium by selling put spreads only in VIX/VIX3M contango. Mirror image of the VWAP book, which buys premium.
strategies.rule_sketch: Gate on VIX/VIX3M < 0.95 and VIX not at the cheap extreme. Sell ~15-delta put, buy 1% lower. Exit at 50% max profit, 2× credit stop, or 21 DTE.

strategies.name: Calendar effects
strategies.holding_period: A few sessions around the event
strategies.summary: Turn-of-month drift, FOMC announcement drift, and opex-week patterns on the index future.
strategies.rule_sketch: Long around month-end / FOMC / opex windows from fomc_dates.csv. Fill next open; flat after the window. Costs always on.

strategies.name: MNQ CVD / VWAP
strategies.summary: Absorption: price makes a new session extreme but CVD does not. Fade back to VWAP. Microstructure, not Renko/MCO.
strategies.rule_sketch: Session CVD + VWAP σ-bands on 1-minute MNQ. Enter on divergence at the band; target VWAP; time stop 60 bars.

strategies.name: Sector rotation
strategies.instruments: 11 SPDR sector ETFs + 13 liquid industry ETFs
strategies.summary: Cross-sectional momentum across sector and industry ETFs: long the leaders, book vol-targeted, cash (T-bill yield) when the 200-day filter fails.
strategies.rule_sketch: Rank the 24 sector/industry ETFs on blended 3/6/12-month return (skip last week). Hold top N above their SMA200, else that slot is cash earning ^IRX. Equal weights, book scaled to an ex-ante vol target (gross <= 1), monthly rebalance at the next open, 5 bps turnover cost.

strategies.name: Breadth regime
strategies.instruments: Regime switch from ~500-name breadth; P&L shown on SPY
strategies.summary: Breadth (% of NSDQ250 names above their 50-day) as a regime input for the equity sleeves. Tested as switch, hysteresis switch and position-sizer on a SPY/SMA200 base.
strategies.rule_sketch: Base = SPY long above its SMA200. 'scaled': full size when >thr% of names are above their 50-day, `floor` size otherwise. 'hyst': ON above thr, OFF below thr-band. 'pct50': hard switch. Writes results/07_breadth_regime_regime.csv for 01 (--regime-file). Finding: gating 01's pullback entries on breadth lowers return more than drawdown (a dip-buyer wants washed-out breadth), so 01 runs ungated.

strategies.name: PEAD / implied move
strategies.instruments: NSDQ250 / S&P large-cap universe (~520 names with earnings history)
strategies.holding_period: 20 trading days after the reaction day
strategies.summary: Post-earnings drift, conditioned on a real EPS beat: long names whose reaction beat the expected move AND whose EPS surprise is >= 10%, skipping reaction days that closed at the top of their range. No stop (post-event noise triggers stops and forfeits the drift).
strategies.rule_sketch: Reaction = first post-announcement close / pre close - 1; expected move = mean |reaction| of the last 8 events. Long at the next open when reaction >= move_mult x expected (floor 2%), EPS beat >= 10%, reaction-day close <= 80% of its range. Hold 20 days, no stop, 20 equal slots, biggest surprise first. Event study (9.6k events): unconditioned drift is SPY beta; EPS-beat filter carries +0.7%/20d excess (t=2.6); shorts after misses have positive drift so are excluded.

strategies.name: ML meta-label on PEAD trades
strategies.instruments: 08_pead_implied_move trades.csv (long post-earnings drift), features from daily bars + ^VIX + SPX HMM regime
strategies.summary: Overlay, not a trade generator: a LightGBM meta-model scores each PEAD entry on the primary's own trades and either skips it (p < m_skip x breakeven) or doubles it (p >= m_boost x breakeven). Purged walk-forward folds with a 2-day embargo, thresholds tuned inside each fold, DSR against the shared trial_log family.
strategies.rule_sketch: ml/meta_label.py --primary trades --trades-csv results/08_pead_implied_move/trades.csv. Label = pnl > 0 on the primary's fills; features at signal time only (returns, vol, dollar volume, VIX percentile, SPX regime state). Verdict = base vs meta on the same out-of-fold trades.

strategies.name: ML meta-label on pullback trades
strategies.instruments: 01_mean_reversion pullback trades.csv (RSI-2 pullbacks above SMA200, ~500 names), features from daily bars + ^VIX + SPX HMM regime
strategies.summary: Overlay on the tuned pullback sleeve: meta-model decides which limit-fill pullbacks to skip or size up. Same purged walk-forward protocol; judged only on the uplift over the ungated primary on identical out-of-fold trades.
strategies.rule_sketch: ml/meta_label.py --primary trades --trades-csv results/01_mean_reversion_pullback/trades.csv. Skip below 1.0x breakeven probability, boost above the tuned multiple; live thresholds p_skip_live / p_boost_live are written to metrics.json for the paper phase.

strategies.name: ML meta-label on V221 (MNQ)
strategies.instruments: MNQ 1-min bars (V221 renko/brick primary re-simulated), ^VXN vol, SPX HMM regime
strategies.summary: Does a meta-model on V221's trades earn its keep? The primary is the live futures bot's rule set re-simulated on MNQ 1-min bars; the overlay skips or sizes those trades. Margin per unit 2500 for the Reg-T/margin KPI.
strategies.rule_sketch: ml/meta_label.py --primary v221 --symbol MNQ --vol-symbol ^VXN --regime spx. Read the base-vs-meta block and the P&L of the skipped trades before anything else. Passing card -> paper for three months with p_skip_live / p_boost_live from metrics.json; nothing changes the live bot.

strategies.name: HMM regime gate on PEAD trades
strategies.instruments: ^GSPC / ^VIX daily -> 3-state Gaussian HMM (prefix-decoded, refit every 63 days); gates 08_pead_implied_move trades
strategies.summary: Regime overlay: trades are only allowed in states whose trailing 252-day per-state expectancy on the primary's own trades is positive (min 15 trades). Prefix decoding and dwell time keep the state causal.
strategies.rule_sketch: ml/regime_hmm.py --symbol ^GSPC --vol-symbol ^VIX --trades-csv results/08_pead_implied_move/trades.csv --name gate_08. Output = the gated trade list and equity; compare with the ungated primary.
